{'text': '天文台預計，今天的室外最高氣溫為 34 度，接近 2022 年的「最熱大暑」 34.9 度，相比去年「大暑」高約 4 度。', 'absentees': []}

{'text': '天文台持續發出酷熱天氣警告，預測今日大致天晴，但上午至中午會有部分地區有驟雨，日間氣溫酷熱。另外，因副熱帶高壓脊為香港帶來晴朗，但沿岸亦會受驟雨影響。', 'absentees': []}

{'text': 'The Hong Kong Observatory continues to issue the Very Hot Weather Warning, forecasting generally fine conditions today, though there will be showers in some areas from morning to noon, with extremely hot temperatures during the day. Additionally, a subtropical ridge brings sunny weather to Hong Kong, but coastal areas will also be affected by showers.', 'absentees': []}

{'text': 'Looking back at past Da Shu (Major Heat) periods, the highest temperature recorded was 34.9 degrees in 2022, while the lowest was 22.2 degrees in 1965.', 'absentees': []}

{'text': 'Furthermore, in past years during Da Shu, the highest average relative humidity and the highest total rainfall were 96% and 195.1 millimetres respectively in 1994, while the lowest average relative humidity was 70% in 1968.', 'absentees': []}
